Before removing conditions in Milton, ask these 3 questions. 1) Is my financing fully approved, in writing, for this exact property? 2) Did I read the inspection report and price any big repairs? 3) Has my lawyer reviewed the agreement and explained my deposit?

A buyer asked me: what cash is needed beyond the down payment? Four things to plan for: 1) Ontario land transfer tax, due on closing. 2) Your lawyer's fees and disbursements. 3) Title insurance, usually arranged through your lawyer. 4) Property tax or utility adjustments, plus moving costs.

Send this to someone saving for their first home. General information only, not legal, tax or mortgage advice. Your lawyer can confirm the exact amounts for your purchase.

Submitting an offer in Cambridge? Check these 4 things first. 1) Your pre-approval: know the price you're comfortable with, not just your maximum. 2) Conditions: decide which ones protect you, like financing and inspection. 3) Deposit: know the amount and when it must be delivered. 4) Offer expiry, closing date and inclusions: put it all in writing.
